reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful experience! They kindly took us in without an appointment when my cat Harper needed help with an embedded nail. Dr. Guirguis, while new to the firm, has brought that same level of care  that I have learned to expect and receive from Leaside Animal Clinic.

wonderful people and service couldn't be happier

I’ve been a client of the Leaside Animal Clinic for nearly 30 years.  I’ve always found the care my pets received to be absolutely first rate.  The staff are kind and compassionate and know the veterinary field inside and out.  About 16 years ago I went to another vet.  Not because of any problems at all with the Leaside Animal Clinic, but rather because I moved and the other vet was only a few blocks away.  That turned out to be a huge mistake.  The other vet clinic was terrible and my poor pets received horrible care.  I couldn’t get back to the great staff at the Leaside Animal Clinic fast enough.  I never should have left.  My experience with the Leaside Animal Clinic has been great, at no time more so than when my pets have taken sick.  They couldn’t have been in better hands and, sadly, eventually end of life care is required and both Dr. Kennedy and Dr. Weintrop were the best.  They helped me get through a rough time with their kindness and professionalism.  I highly recommend the Leaside Animal Clinic.

We recently had to say goodbye to our beloved cat, Rustle, after 14 years together, and I wanted to take a moment to thank the entire team at Leaside Animal Clinic, especially Dr. Weintrop.

We found Rustle in 2012 living as a stray behind a Home Depot. Not long after we brought him home, he fractured his leg in two places while out exploring his new neighborhood. Leaside Animal Clinic cared for him through that recovery, which included several weeks under their supervision while his leg healed. That was the beginning of a relationship that would last the rest of his life.

Over the years, whenever Rustle needed help, Leaside Animal Clinic was there. Whether it was dental work, routine care, unexpected health concerns, or simply helping us navigate the challenges of caring for a senior cat, we always felt that Rustle was in capable and compassionate hands.

What always stood out to us was the honesty and professionalism of the team. We never felt pressured into unnecessary treatments. Options were explained clearly, costs were discussed openly, and recommendations were made based on what was best for Rustle. Dr. Weintrop, in particular, always approached decisions with both medical expertise and genuine compassion. More than once she would explain what she would do if Rustle were her own cat, which we always appreciated.

During Rustle's final months Dr. Weintrop helped guide us through some very difficult decisions with kindness, patience, and honesty. While losing him has been incredibly painful, we take comfort in knowing that he received excellent care throughout his life.

Rustle was a special cat, and we were fortunate to have him for so many years. We are equally grateful to the team at Leaside Animal Clinic who helped care for him throughout that journey.

Thank you for everything you did for our boy.
Staff was so friendly and helpful, and Dr.Ruth is the best vet we've been to in the city. So happy to make this our new home for our dog.

I can’t say enough good things about this clinic. Every member of the team is kind, patient, and genuinely invested in the well‑being of the animals they care for. They always take the time to explain things clearly, answer every question, and make sure both me and my cat feel comfortable. My cat is actually not scared and loves Dr. Natallia Rutchanka, which says everything. I’m deeply grateful for their expertise, compassion, and consistency. Truly exceptional care.
Dr. Natallia was wonderful and very helpful! Would highly recommend.
Caring, patient and highly qualified specialists. No more, no less, but exactly what the animal needs. This is very important and highly valued. Special thanks to Natalia for my senior dog.

Words simply cannot capture the overwhelming joy and profound gratitude I felt during my visit to your incredible clinic. What I believed would be a routine bandage change for my dog’s amputation wound turned into a breathtaking display of expertise, compassion, and dedication that left me absolutely speechless.

Your remarkable team didn’t just go through the motions — they went far and above the call of duty, identifying that the wound had become infected and delivering exceptional,  care that I never could have anticipated. Their vigilance and thoroughness were nothing short of extraordinary.

I am so deeply thankful for the outstanding level of service, love, and professionalism your clinic embodies. You are truly angels in scrubs, and my dog and I are forever grateful to have you in our corner. Thank you from the absolute bottom of my heart!

I’ve been a client of Leaside Animal Clinic for over 16 years and plan to continue as long as they’re in business. In December, I lost my beloved cat of 15 years, Nikki, and the kindness I received was overwhelming. I got a beautifully written card with a heartfelt note from Dr. Rutchanka, who had cared for Nikki for many years. Nikki could be quite the handful at the clinic—it was just her personality—but the entire team was always kind and never made me feel awkward about her behavior. Every visit was filled with warmth and genuine compassion. Recently, I adopted a senior cat, Misty, who has also started seeing the wonderful team. She met with Dr. Rutchanka this week, and it turns out she also has a bit of a temper—she even swatted at the doctor’s face! Still, Dr. Rutchanka was amazing with her and gave her the best care. What truly blew me away was how the bill was handled. I signed Misty up for their Pet Club Plan, which has a very reasonable monthly rate, and I expected a bill of $600–$800 based on past experiences, but it was just over $100. I was speechless and so grateful they offer this plan. In all my years going there, I’ve never felt pressured into unnecessary tests, and they’ve always tried to keep costs low. Anytime I’ve called with questions, they’ve shown how much they care. The team is kind, empathetic, and makes you feel good about bringing your furry family member in. If you’re looking for a new vet, consider this clinic—you’ll know right away your pet will get impeccable care.

Allan, Misty and the late Nikki

I would like to provide a balanced review on our experience with our dog’s appointment for an acute presentation.

Positives: The front desk staff and veterinary professionals are friendly and welcoming. We called in the morning and they were able to help assess our dog in the afternoon with a same-day appointment. The clinic is well equipped to begin addressing and managing a common acute presentation which our dog had. The differential diagnosis list was fairly thorough with a good management plan. We received good initial medications and management. When follow up phone calls did occur, focused follow up questions were helpful in trending and addressing the progression of our dog’s symptoms.

Negatives: We were advised to complete stool and blood testing, and were advised that the stool test result and at least some of the basic blood works would come back the next day while some may take 1-3 days, and that we will receive a phone call regarding some of the blood work results the next day. This is important because some of these results may inform or change current management plan of our dog’s acute presentation and would further consolidate specific diagnoses. As we kept our eyes open for a call the next day, we did not receive any. We did receive a call two days after the visit, confirming negative stool testing results, which was reassuring. However, we would’ve appreciated a notification on delayed communication especially given an evolving acute presentation as our dog’s symptoms persisted.

We also did not receive any initial blood work results as promised when we were told the stool results. Five days after the initial visit, we did not receive further followup calls regarding the bloodwork results, and called in to confirm. Thankfully our dog’s symptoms were improving by then, and most blood work values were reassuring. However, timely blood work results and follow up as promised are expected, especially when these important results may inform/change management in addressing an acute presentation. Therefore, in this case, delayed follow-up on these blood work results rendered completing them in the first place moot.

Finally, we did confirm a quote for the assessment and management during consultation and assessment with the veterinarian, because we communicated that we did not have insurance and wanted to prepare accordingly. We were given an upper three digits range. However the final invoice was nearly double the initial range given, in the four digits range. We would have appreciated more transparency and accurate quote when inquired in the beginning.

This experience combined with prior summaries, suggests more transparent, accurate and  timely communication especially during the management of an acute presentation.
